description: Election Commission - Declare that B. M. A. K. Balasooriya as a Member of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral matters including candidate nominations, registrations, and declarations.
